verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online has a native 'Bank Rules' feature that lets users define conditions to auto-categorize/match transactions, confirmed by a community comment referencing 'automatic rules build right into QuickBooks Online,' plus docs on automated invoice reminders and auto-matching payments. However, the same community source notes rules 'cannot be applied to these transactions' in some cases, and there is no first-party documentation detailing rule configuration, trigger types, or workflow automation scope. Missing for 10: first-party docs on rule-builder UI/conditions, evidence of broader event-triggered workflow automation beyond bank transaction matching, and independent corroboration of reliability at scale.
